Client.description: Client account profile: name, program, services, retainer, assigned CSM, website, Google Ads / GA4 / GHL identifiers.

ClientInsight.description: Client tracker records: AI summary, to-dos and red flags (with resolved state, team assignment, resolution notes), meeting date.

ClientScore.description: Monthly client scorecard: grades (A-F) per category with notes, overall grade, roadblocks.

ClientContact.description: Client contact profiles: questionnaire answers, AI prep sheet, timeline notes.

Onboarding.description: Onboarding records with summary notes and uploaded transcript/form references.

PostMortem.description: Offboarding post-mortems: reason, date, summary notes.

WillMeeting.description: Will's meeting records with parsed summary, highlights, action items, sentiment.

PPCData.description: PPC performance per client per period: spend, impressions, clicks, CPC, CTR, conversions, notes.

GAData.description: GA4 analytics per client per period: sessions, users, pageviews, bounce rate, top pages, traffic sources.

SEOData.description: SEO performance per client per period: organic clicks, impressions, average position, top keywords/pages, GBP metrics.

LeadData.description: Lead performance per client per period: leads, appointments, closed deals, revenue, source breakdowns.

UptimeCheck.description: Website uptime check history: status, response code, response time.
